title: Unit conversions
sentences: A conversion factor is a ratio of equal quantities, such as 100 cm / 1 m.
Multiply so the old unit cancels.
Area has two dimensions, so square a length conversion factor; volume has three, so cube it.
Speed combines a distance unit and a time unit, which may both need converting.
Convert 72 km/h to meters per second.
One hour contains 3,600 seconds, so divide 72,000 by 3,600.
The distance traveled in one second is 20 meters.
spoken: A conversion factor is a ratio of equal quantities, such as 100 centimeters divided by 1 meter.
Multiply so the old unit cancels.
Area has two dimensions, so square a length conversion factor; volume has three, so cube it.
Speed combines a distance unit and a time unit, which may both need converting.
Convert 72 kilometers per hour to meters per second.
72 kilometers per hour times 1,000 meters divided by kilometers equals 72,000 meters per hour.
One hour contains 3,600 seconds, so divide 72,000 by 3,600.
72 kilometers per hour equals 20 meters per second.
The distance traveled in one second is 20 meters.
